verbatim_quote.original: keep the single opencode-server (v2.0.19, external serve mode) and single OpenChamber service healthy.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: keep the single opencode-server (v2.0.19, external serve mode) and single OpenChamber service healthy.

extracted_decision.summary: Manager requires that the existing opencode-server and OpenChamber service remain healthy during the MCP singleton rollout.
extracted_decision.rationale: To avoid disrupting the working environment while changing MCP server architecture.
alternatives: Allow restarting or repairing opencode-server as part of the rollout
Permit OpenChamber to be reconfigured or restarted
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Constrains implementation options but preserves existing services; May require additional health checks and rollback safeguards
